history.historical_narrative: Chero raja Manan Singh ke aahwan par bhakt Rahshu ke shish ko chir kar Mata Kamakhya yahan prakat hui thin. 1714 AD me Hathwa shashak ne vartaman mandir banwaya.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Kamakhya (Assam) se Thawe yatra; Rahshu Bhagat mandir darshan ke bina yatra adhoori maani jati hai.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Nisha Puja aur Chaitra Navratri mela.

history.historical_narrative: 1666 AD me Sikh dharam ke 10vein Guru, Guru Gobind Singh Ji ka janam yahan hua tha. Takht Sri Patna Sahib Sikh panth ke 5 takhton me se ek hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Guru Gobind Singh ji ke bachpan ke chholey aur kangan leela sthal.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Gatka martial art pradarshan, Shabad Kirtan aur Prabhat Pheri.

history.historical_narrative: Bhagwan Vishnu ke 6the avtar Bhagwan Parshuram ke prakatya diwas par aayojit mela jo nyaya aur tap ka prateek hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Kshatriya atyachar ke khilaf shastra uthane ki pauranik gatha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Shastra puja, havan aur dharmik shobhayatra.

history.historical_narrative: Punaura Dham (Sitamarhi) me Raja Janak ne hal chalaya tha jahan se Mata Sita ka prakatya hua maana jata hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Sita Janmotsav badhai geet aur Panthpakar vishram sthali.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Sita kund snan aur Maithili Ramayan katha.

dynasties: Gupta and Post-Gupta Era (circa 108 AD / 4th-7th Century)
history.historical_narrative: Bharat ka sabse prachin niranter puja wala ashtakoniya (octagonal) mandir. Brahmi lipi me Gupta-kalin abhilekh prapt hue hain.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Chand aur Mund asuron ka sangharsh.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Ahinsak Bali (Bina rakt bahaye bakra murchhit hokar punah jeevit hota hai).

history.historical_narrative: Grand Trunk Road, Rupiya sikka aur Zabti revenue system chalane wale Sher Shah Suri ka laal balua patthar se bana ashtakoniya maqbara Sasaram ki jheel me sthit hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Farid Khan dwara ek hi vaar me sher maarne ki veer-katha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Sufiana qawwali aur aitihasik sangosthi.

history.historical_narrative: Gaya kshetra me sthit prachin Shaivite teerth sthal jahan Shravan me lakho kavadia jalabhishek karte hain.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Manokamna purti aur rog mukti ki lok astha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Rudrabhishek, Belpatra aur Gangajal arpan.

history.historical_narrative: Darbhanga Raj dwara sthapit dharmik peethon me Hanuman ji aur Shiva ki aradhana ka kendra.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Mahamari aur sankat nivaran hetu sankatmochan poojan.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Sundarkand path, Ramcharitmanas navaah parayan.

dynasties: Mauryan Era vicinity (Lauriya Areraj Ashokan Pillar)
history.historical_narrative: Areraj me sthit Someshwarnath Mahadev mandir ko panchnad kshetra ka prachintam Shivling maana jata hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Chandra devta ne shraap mukti ke liye yahan shivaling sthapit kiya tha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Jaladhari jalabhishek aur kavad yatra.

dynasties: Holkar Dynasty (Ahilyabai Holkar rebuilt Vishnupad in 1787)
history.historical_narrative: Puranon ke anusar Lord Rama ne Falgu tat par Pita Dasharatha ke liye pind daan kiya tha. Ahilyabai Holkar ne 1787 me vartaman Vishnupad mandir ka nirman karwaya tha.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Gayasur ki pavitra deh par Vishnu ke pad-chinh aur Mata Sita dwara Falgu nadi ko shraap.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: 48 Vedis me Pind Daan, Tarpan aur Gayawal Panda parampra.

history.historical_narrative: 1917 Champaran Satyagraha Bharat me Gandhiji ka pehla sapaal satyagraha tha, jisme Tinkathia indigo pratha ko kanoonan samapt karwaya gaya.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Raj Kumar Shukla dwara Lucknow Congress adhiveshan (1916) me Gandhi ji ko Bihar aane ke liye prerit karne ki katha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Charkha katan pradarshani, Sarva Dharma Sabha.

events.title: Maa Tara Devi Siddhi Peeth Mahotsav

history.historical_narrative: Pala kaal me Magadh Vajrayana aur Shakta upasana ka sangam sthal bana. Tara Devi ko dus Mahavidyaon me dushra sthan prapt hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Samudra manthan ke samay Shiva ke vish-paan uprant Mata Tara dwara stanyapaan se sheetal karne ki gatha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Nisha puja, Chandi path aur Kanya pujan.

dynasties: Pala Era & Karnata Dynasty of Mithila
history.historical_narrative: Mahishi (Saharsa) sthit Ugratara mandir wahi sthal hai jahan Adi Shankaracharya aur Vidwan Mandan Mishra ke beech aitihasik shastrartha hua tha.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Ubhay Bharati dwara Shankaracharya ko shastrartha me chunauti dene ki gatha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Tantrik Mahashtami balidan aur Maithili sangeet sandhya.

dynasties: Ancient Naga-Folk Cults of North Bihar
history.historical_narrative: Sarpa-dosh nivaran aur kheti-badi me sarp-bhay mukti ke liye Mansa Devi aradhana Tirhut kshetra ki lok-parampara hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Bihula-Lakhindar aur Mansa Devi se judi lok-kathayein.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Dudh aur Kela arpan anushthan.

history.historical_narrative: Mithila me Kartik maas me ek maas tak sadhu aur grihasth dwara kalpwas (tapasya aur niyamit shuddha aahar) karne ki prachin parampara.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Kalpwas se dehik va mansik shuddhi ki lok manyata.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Nadi snan, Akhand Sankirtan aur Sant Samagam.

history.historical_narrative: Kamtaul (Darbhanga) sthit Ahilya Sthan me Bhagwan Shri Ram ke charan sparsh se Mata Ahilya ka shraap-mukti (Ahilya Uddhar) hua tha.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Shila bani Ahilya ke taranhar Shri Ram ki katha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Gautam Kund snan aur Ramcharitmanas path.

history.historical_narrative: Asia ka sabse bada pashu mela. Chandragupta Maurya yahan se yuddha-hathi khareedte the. 1857 me Babu Veer Kunwar Singh ne krantikariyon ki baithak yahi aayojit ki thi.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Gaj aur Grah (Gajendra Moksha) sangharsh; Harihar Nath mandir jahan Vishnu aur Shiva ek roop me sthit hain.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Kartik Purnima Mahasnan Ganga-Gandak sangam par.
culture_and_tradition.special_offering: Sonpur Khaja aur Local Sweet Delicacies

history.historical_narrative: Prachin Magadha ki pratham rajdhani Girivraja (Rajgir). Yahan 483 BC me pehli Buddhist Council Saptaparni cave me aayojit hui thi.

geography_and_circuit.tourism_circuit: Buddhist & Jain Heritage Circuit, Eco-Tourism (Glass Bridge, Ropeway)

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Jarasandha ka Akhara aur Venuvana me Buddha ke pravachan.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Vishwa Shanti Stupa Vandana, Classical dance performance.

history.historical_narrative: Mir Qasim ne 1762 me Bengal ki rajdhani Murshidabad se Munger sthanantarit ki aur hathiyar karkhana sthapit kiya. Yahan Bihar School of Yoga (World first Yoga University) sthit hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Karna ke mahadaan ki katha aur Sita Kund garm jal kund.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Ganga aarti Kashtaharani ghat par aur Yog satra.

history.historical_narrative: Manyata ke anusar yahan sthit Uchchait Bhagwati mandir me Mahakavi Kalidasa ne devi aradhana se gyan prapt kiya tha.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Kalidasa dwara kaali raat me devi ki peeth par granth likhne ki gatha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Vidya aarambh sanskar aur Maithili kavi-sammelan.

dynasties: Gidhaur Chandel Rajput Estate (Founded in 1262 AD)
history.historical_narrative: Gidhaur riyasat ke aitihasik kile (Minto Tower) aur Garhi Dham ka mahatva. Gidhaur ke shashakon ne Baidyanath Dham mandir sanctum ka nirman karwaya tha.

geography_and_circuit.region: Kiul River Basin / Chota Nagpur border

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Chandel rajaon ki veer gatha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Devi Garhi puja aur traditional tribal Paika nritya.

history.historical_narrative: Mithila ki sanskriti, Maithili sahitya aur kala ka shreshth manch. Raj Darbhanga ne Sanskrit gyan aur sangeet ko vishal sanrakshan diya tha.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Vidyapati ke sangeet par Shiva ke sevak banne ki Ugna katha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Samdaun, Batgamani aur Nachari gaayan; Paan-Makhana aadar satkar.

history.historical_narrative: Barabar Caves (Vanavar Pahadi) Bharat ki sabse prachin rock-cut caves hain jinhe Ashoka aur Dasharatha ne Ajivika sampradaya ke liye banwaya tha. Yahan Baba Siddhnath mandir sthit hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Banasur dwara shivaling puja aur Barabar gufaon ka acoustic echo chamatkar.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Baba Siddhnath jalabhishek aur heritage trek.

history.historical_narrative: Tapovan apne prakritik Sulphur hot springs ke liye prasiddh hai jahan rishi-muni tap karte the.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Garm kund snan se twacha vikar mukti.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Makar Sankranti snan, Surya arghya aur daan.

history.historical_narrative: Bhawani Bigha / Vishnudham me Bhagwan Vishnu ki prachin shila murti sthit hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Khet se prakat hui Vishnu pratima ki lok astha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Makar Sankranti snan aur Vishnu Sahasranama path.

history.historical_narrative: Samudra Manthan me mathani banne wala Mandar Parvat. Bhagwan Vasupujya ka nirmaan sthal.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Papharni kund snan se Chola raja ka kushtha rog door hone ki katha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Madhusudan Bhagwan ki rathayatra aur Papharni snan.

history.historical_narrative: Rajgir ke Brahmakund aur Surajkund jaise 22 kundon me Makar Sankranti ke din pavitra snan karne lakho shraddhalu aate hain.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Brahma ji dwara aayojit yagya me 33 koti devi-devtaon ka aagaman.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Brahmakund snan aur Surya arghya.

dynasties: Treta Yuga origin lore / Solanki architectural style
history.historical_narrative: Dev Sun Temple Bharat ka ekmatra Pashchimabhimukhi (West-facing) surya mandir hai jo bina choona/cement ke patthar jodkar banaya gaya hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Rath Saptami par Bhagwan Surya ke 7 ghodon wale rath ki pooja aur Chhath Mahaparv ka sthal.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Surya Kund snan, Arghya aur Surya Sahasranama paath.

history.historical_narrative: Bodh Gaya me Bodhi Vriksha ke niche Gautam Buddha ko Sambodhi (Enlightenment) prapt hui thi. Mahabodhi Temple UNESCO World Heritage Site (2002) hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Sujata dwara khilaayi gayi kheer jisse Buddha ne apna kathin tap toba tha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: International Shanti March, Sutra chanting Mahabodhi vriksha ke neeche.

history.historical_narrative: Mithila ke sour-panchang aur Vedic Surya upasana ka kendra jahan jyotish vidya ka pradarshan hota hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Saurath Sabha aur nakshatra ganana ki aitihasik parampra.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Adityahridayam Stotra paath aur Surya namaskar.

history.historical_narrative: Rohtasgarh Kila Bharat ke sabse abhedya pahadi kilon me se ek hai jise 16th century me Raja Man Singh ne shashan mukhyalaya banaya tha.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Hathi Pol gate, Aina Mahal aur Chaurasan mandir.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Veer Ras kavi sammelan aur heritage trekking.

history.historical_narrative: Umga Pahad par 52 prachin mandiron ki shrankhala thi, jise Chhota Konark bhi kaha jata hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Umgeshwari Devi ko pahadi kshetra ki kuldevi ke roop me puja jata hai.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Devi aarti aur pahad parikrama.

history.historical_narrative: Morhar aur Dhadhar nadiyon ke sangam ke paas sthit prachin shivaling mandir.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Banasur dwara shivaling sthapana ki manyata.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: 24-hour Akhand Kirtan aur Jalabhishek.

history.historical_narrative: Mahendranath (Mehandar) mandir ke paas lagbhag 550 bigha me phaila vishalkay 'Kamal Dah' sarovar sthit hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Kamal Dah ke pavitra jal se snan karne par raja ka rog theek hone ki katha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Sarovar snan aur Shivling par jalabhishek.

history.historical_narrative: Ramayana kalin manyata ke anusar Shringi Rishi ne Raja Dasharatha ke liye 'Putrakameshti Yajna' yahi aayojit kiya tha.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Santan prapti hetu Singheshwar Sthan par manokamna maangne ki parampara.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Maha Shivratri Mahasnan aur Kosi folk sangeet.

history.historical_narrative: Nalanda ke baad prachin vishwa ka sabse bada Buddhist Vishwavidyalaya. Dharmapala ne ise sthapit kiya tha aur ye Vajrayana Buddhism ka pradhan kendra tha.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Atisha Dipankara ki Tibet yatra aur Vajrayana shastra charcha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Tibetan chants, heritage walk aur classical performances.
culture_and_tradition.special_offering: Katarani Rice Chura aur Bhagalpuri Peda

history.historical_narrative: Kosi kshetra me sarp-dansh nivaran aur prakritik aapadaon se suraksha hetu Vishahara (Manasa) Devi ki upasana.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Bihula-Vishahari gatha jo Manjusha Art ka mukhya aadhar hai.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Bhagat nach (traditional trance dance) aur stuti.

history.historical_narrative: Kaimur ki ghani gufaon me lagbhag 1.5 km lambi prakritik limestone gufa me sthit Gupteshwar Mahadev stalagmite shivaling.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Bhasmasur se bachne hetu Shiva ke yahan chhipne aur Mohini roop me asur vadh ki katha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Gufa bheetar niranter jal tapakne wale shivaling par arghya.

history.historical_narrative: Mithila sanskrit, tarkashastra (Navya-Nyaya) aur Madhubani chitrakaala (GI Tagged) ka vishwa-vikhyat kendra hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Kobar ghar aur Aripana lok kala shaili.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Hori-gayan, Jhijhiya nritya aur Madhubani art exhibitions.

history.historical_narrative: Rigveda me Koshi ko Kausiki kaha gaya hai. Ye festival Kosi ke lok-jeevan, sangharsh aur sangeet ka utsav hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Koshi Maiya ki kripa aur sangharsh par aadharit lok-geet.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Koshi Nadi Maha-Aarti aur boat racing.

history.historical_narrative: Pipra (Motihari) sthit Sita Kund mandir jahan Janakpur vivah uprant Ayodhya laut-te samay Shri Ram aur Sita ji ke vishram ki manyata hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Sita ji dwara kund ke jal se kankan dho-ne ki lok katha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Sita Kund snan aur Ramcharitmanas path.

history.historical_narrative: Jain Shwetambar parampara me Jamui ke Lachhuar/Kundagram ko Bhagwan Mahavira ki janmasthali maana jata hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Vardhaman ke balyakaal aur ahimsa aadarshon ki gatha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Mahavira Panchamrit Abhishek aur Navkar Mantra jaap.

history.historical_narrative: Digambar Jain manyata ke anusar Nalanda ka Kundalpur Bhagwan Mahavira ka janmasthal hai jahan vishal Nandyavarta Mahal sthit hai.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Mahavira dwara 30 varsh ki aayu me ghor tapasya hetu deeksha lene ki gatha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Shanti Dhara anushthan aur Rath Yatra.

history.historical_narrative: Vaishali vishwa ka pratham ganatantra (First Republic) tha. Bhagwan Buddha ne yahan antim pravachan diya tha aur Mahaprajapati Gautami ko Bhikkhuni sangh me shamil kiya tha.

culture_and_tradition.local_folklore: Amrapali ka aamravan daan aur Licchavi sansthagar ganatantra katha.
culture_and_tradition.rituals: Relic Stupa peace march aur Licchavi ganatantra natak manchan.
